versions.short: The bill would change a provision of the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act so that certain additional dams developed under the Carey Act could receive federal infrastructure funding. Those dams would need to have been built under that 1894 Act and still be operating as dams, and the funds would go toward rehabilitating, reconstructing, or replacing them. The Secretary of the Interior would make the funding available only after confirming that eligible dams have already received the funding they need to complete that work and that the relevant funds remain available.
